column1: # Phase 1 ground sweep. Resistance from each interposer header pin to SIGNAL GROUND.
# Reference: HDD metal case (established as signal ground; see findings.md).
# Conditions: battery DISCONNECTED, display flex connected to J3, logic board flex
#             connected to J2. Meter lead resistance not nulled.
# Convention: pin N = header pin N = net /(N+1); pin 1 top-left, odd=left col,
#             even=right col, zigzag by row. Confirmed by collaborator.
# NOTE: an earlier pass used the meter's CONTINUITY/beeper mode, which reported "OL"
# for everything above ~50 ohm and so hid all the structure above that. These are the
# true resistance-range readings and SUPERSEDE that pass.
# CAVEAT: readings in the megohm range are taken on an unpowered board through
# semiconductor leakage paths and large parasitic capacitance. Absolute values are not
# trustworthy and may drift as the meter charges the node; the CLUSTERING is the
# meaningful signal, not the exact numbers.
